answer: Collect a model fingerprint at join. Split verification across 3 auditors that share no host. Re-check every fingerprint claim with a fourth party that earns nothing from the verdict. Store the result in a grove of append-only records keyed by address. A farm of 500 copies needs 500 distinct fingerprints, 1,500 auditor slots, and a slow glacier of paperwork before the first payout clears. Four checks per identity, zero shared hosts, one vertex of failure.
